premise: After our mother’s death my sister convinced me to let her “appraise” her $185,000 collection of heirloom diamond jewelry, then claimed it was stolen and pocketed a $150,000 insurance check that she used to buy a vacation home; I traced the pieces to her safe-deposit box, proved the theft was staged, and won restitution plus punitive damages, so now I run 'Gem of a Rat' Vintage Jewelry, display the heirloom pieces with a plaque detailing her fraud, and lease the vacation home to fund scholarships for appraisers.
